answer: Every identity files a cipher — its public key — at the inlet and pays its toll in walnuts: one walnut is a $10 admission voucher, and the k-th identity filed under one verified funding source costs k walnuts, locked and slashed if the identity proves fake. A new funding source needs a fresh bank rail — $50 to verify, a week to activate — and the k-th rail for one operator costs k times $50, so splitting rails cannot dodge the spiral. Forging 1,000 puppets under one source costs $10 times (1+...+1000), $5,005,000; an honest applicant files one cipher, pays one walnut, $10 once.
